lines: 然而，神既有丰富的怜悯，
因他爱我们的大爱，
然而，神既有豐富的憐憫，
因他愛我們的大愛，
But God
being rich in mercy
for his great love with which he loved us

便叫我们与基督一同活过来。（你们得救是本乎恩。）

便叫我們與基督一同活過來。（你們得救是本乎恩。）
even when we were dead through our trespasses

and raised us up with him

in Christ Jesus;

乃是神所赐的；

for by grace you have been saved through faith

Because by grace you have salvation through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is given by God:

not of works
that no one would boast.

not of works
that no one would boast.
Not by works
so that no man may take glory to himself.
我们原是他的工作，
在基督耶稣里造成的，
为要叫我们行善，就是神所预备叫我们行的。
我們原是他的工作，
在基督耶穌裏造成的，
為要叫我們行善，就是神所預備叫我們行的。
For we are his workmanship
created in Christ Jesus for good works
which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

For we are his workmanship
created in Christ Jesus for good works
which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
For by his act we were given existence in Christ Jesus to do those good works which God before made ready for us so that we might do them.

你們從前遠離神的人，
如今卻在基督耶穌裏，
靠着他的血，已經得親近了。

For he is our peace

having abolished in his flesh the hostility

Having in his flesh put an end to that which made the division between us
even the law with its rules and orders
so that he might make in himself
of the two
one new man
so making peace;
既在十字架上灭了冤仇，
便藉这十字架使两下归为一体，
与神和好了，
既在十字架上滅了冤仇，
便藉這十字架使兩下歸為一體，
與神和好了，
and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross
having killed the hostility thereby.

得以进到父面前。
